description: Per-character effects inspector for combat UI. Read-only card selection independent from initiative, action target and ongoing draft. Explicit Bless targeting and disclosure.

bless.bonus: 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws; not damage, AC or checks
visibility: concentration and target list on caster card
detailed bonus in attack and saving throw log

notes: Casting Bless never changes selected inspector automatically unless player opts for it.
This is UI design metadata, not canonical battle state or complete implementation.
